⚠️ Highly Disappointing Experience - Beware

I had a very bad experience with Paresh Kanshiyal and his team.

I got the filters changed for my Aquaguard Ritz RO + UV in Aug’25, and within just 6 months, the water quality became extremely poor, with abnormally low TDS levels. This was surprising since our society water usually stays around 70–80 PPM.

When I contacted them for a check, instead of diagnosing the issue, their team casually said the filters must already be खराब and need replacement again. This felt completely unreasonable within such a short time.

Out of frustration, I called the official Aquaguard service team. On inspection, they clearly identified that the filters installed were fake:

QR code was not scanning
QR was pasted, not printed
Overall build quality was not genuine

❗ Please be careful and avoid such service providers. Always go with authorized service to ensure genuine parts or check the products beforehand.

DO NOT TRUST THIS SERVICE PROVIDER, VERY POOR SERVICE
I am writing this review for Acqua Service Centre for their poor service because of which significant damages have incurred due to their negligence. I have engaged Acqua Service Centre for water purifier maintenance services, but the experience turned into a nightmare.

Initially, despite receiving payment in advance, Acqua Service Centre failed to provide a technician as scheduled. When I brought this to the attention of Senior Representative Mr. Paresh, he irresponsibly handed me the technician, Mr. Suraj's contact information, expecting me to directly engage with him. However, Mr. Suraj consistently ignored my calls and arrived hours after the promised time.

The technician, upon his visit, ostensibly resolved the issue with the water purifier. Regrettably, the same night, a catastrophic event unfolded as the pipe that was supposedly fixed ruptured, leading to extensive flooding throughout my residence. The water seeped into various areas, reaching the lift lobby and causing irreparable damage to the wooden flooring. Additionally, the force of the water jammed the doors.

Upon reporting the incident to Mr. Paresh, he initially attempted to deflect blame onto me. However, after an altercation, Mr. Suraj confessed to his negligence in failing to secure the water pressure valve before leaving. Despite his assurances of fixing the issue, the pipe broke again later that night.

This ordeal has resulted in immense financial loss and emotional distress. The incompetence and lack of accountability exhibited by Acqua Service Centre are unacceptable. Despite the colossal damages caused directly by their negligence, they have shown no willingness to take responsibility or provide compensation for the extensive harm done to my property.

PLEASE DONT TRUST THIS SERVICE PROVIDER.

As per your last comment on my post you said you have refunded only Rs. 250/- in my account out of 3,000/-.

I had told you to take away your products and since you had not provided us proper service and the damage you have caused to us that is unacceptable.

We have taken examination of your products installed from the authorised service centre of Acquagaurd and they have said that you have used local products and not branded one and have charged us more for the product.

CUSTOMERS PLEASE DONT TRUST THIS SERVICE CENTRE.
